needs.premise: Two invocation identities and two callback levels, one abstract scan lease; valid shell, stopped initialization writer, independent native-only completion and current owner/ABI are premises; no C weak-memory execution or arbitrary callback depth

22 conditional declarations: publication/reentry rejection, root-location/value distinction, custody Step/Trace, distinct result-slot update and reader/borrower/child retirement gates; not complete QNT/C simulation

Close managed writer/admission authority and capture every pre-close root/escrow before release-publishing an immutable descriptor view; root cell values are collector-writable under scan ownership; acquire a separate current-epoch trace receipt, never infer it from view publication

One result slot and invocation generation per actual call, independent of GC epoch; late native-only stores add no managed root and may not overwrite committed slots; body initialization/root registration precede canonical custody commit, and query cannot replay production or allocate a duplicate wrapper

Publish a valid rooted FOREIGN shell with safe default fields or keep private storage unexposed before list admission; exact native duty stays in escrow until canonical commit; partial initialization requires known stopped writer, safe shell and rooted inputs; arbitrary linked/uninitialized current C state is not recoverable by assertion

Every nested callback has its own reserved record/result slot, protected procedure before marker allocation and a complete ancestor chain; respect same-owner C stack, processor marker and invalidation; child errors/delete cannot free active marker/RC/code/native dependencies

After full round seal, acquire current epoch/generation and root relocation result, drain scan leases and restore original context/processor binding before writer authority, marker access or managed result delivery; invalid marker/stale frame cannot be revived

Canonical resource authority transfers at one known commit while root coverage overlaps; native borrowers drain before destructive disposal, receipt/root/code readers and descendants drain before metadata/ticket reuse; result observers do not pin collector view buffers; unknown outcome retains exact custody

Actual C11 release/acquire or lock refinement for writer gate, immutable descriptor publication, trace receipt, canonical slot/custody commit and reentry; root relocation is authorized mutation, not a seqlock excuse for data races; ABI/platform mapping and reclamation wrap remain open

Separate business completion debt from uncovered GC debt: wrapper allocation can itself call GC; captured native result plus frozen complete roots may close GC without returning the constructor. No direct refinement claim to prior total-constructor-zero law; mapping and source pause cuts must be proved

Before native production reserve backed no-GC ticket/root/result slots, exact native leases and code; publish frozen construction view before conversion allocation may GC; retain physical owner across failure, payload capture and wrapper/result root publication

Only known root/custody/authority metadata with native-only bounded effects permits outcome-isolated resume; unknown root writers/profile/slot owner refuses seal. Accepted query is not reexecution, native disposition proof or ticket refund; process side effects and MSG pointer payloads need exact independent profiles

Seal captures current epoch/generation, blocks managed writers, scans all ancestor/callback/root views; active-permit reentry consumes the frozen view and restores managed writer authority before allocation/callback/result delivery; late native-only result stores cannot add managed roots

Owner may wait GC; GC may wait bounded root-view scanning; scanning/cleanup may not acquire owner port mutex, callback permit, PSTATE wait scratch or new collector allocation capacity. Declared rank is valid only if all transitive service/lock edges are covered; no arbitrary native-call timeout guarantee

Accept rollback targets created client not borrowed server; process return-slot failure retains dev/pid/pipe/status and temporary-string duties with original error mapping; Win32 removed message retains MSG/RC and external message ownership; no false replay/rollback of external effects

Release/acquire escrow view and result publication; gate close/reservation capture; borrowed native device/RC chain lifetime; generation-safe result/reader/ticket retirement and no-escape initialization require actual C/platform proof

publicationCosts.removedWork: Freeze root locations/meaning and writer authority while collector updates values
publicationCosts.bound: O(M+R) descriptor registration/scan for M live records and R dependency/result cells
publicationCosts.addedCost: Publication gate, stable cells and distinct trace receipt
publicationCosts.condition: No non-atomic copy/retry of concurrently written root values; actual C race freedom unresolved

publicationCosts.removedWork: Separate per-invocation generation from collection epoch
publicationCosts.bound: One native result slot, at most one wrapper/custody commit per modeled invocation
publicationCosts.addedCost: O(M) slots and identity checks; result query cannot reexecute native work
publicationCosts.condition: Current-generation native-only late results allowed across GC epochs; stale invocation results rejected

publicationCosts.removedWork: Separate parent/child records instead of singleton owner result
publicationCosts.bound: Depth d requires d protected invocation/frame records; bounded model uses two levels
publicationCosts.addedCost: Root/marker/result/error cells and code/native leases per level
publicationCosts.condition: Arbitrary recursive depth needs bounded reservation/backpressure before callback entry; no proof from a depth integer alone

publicationCosts.removedWork: Allow qualified stopped partial initialization to coexist with GC
publicationCosts.bound: Three logical safe default fields before publication plus final field writes and canonical metadata
publicationCosts.addedCost: Extra default initialization/root pin; old direct release dispatch must be replaced
publicationCosts.condition: Logical field assignments, not machine-store counts; opaque scan alone does not protect against cleanup

publicationCosts.removedWork: Transfer one release right while source/target root coverage overlaps
publicationCosts.bound: One authoritative custody/result commit in abstract model; no duplicate credit charge
publicationCosts.addedCost: Side metadata or explicit right handle plus lookup and C-FFI borrow validation
publicationCosts.condition: Existing FOREIGN layout/FFI compatibility requires source proof; no measured lookup cost or automatic ABI preservation

publicationCosts.removedWork: Keep observer result pins separate from collector view leases
publicationCosts.bound: One active round with one builder/published view permits bounded view buffers if every scanner drains
publicationCosts.addedCost: Pre-backed view storage and completion receipts; canonical result slots remain pinned
publicationCosts.condition: External observer cannot hold GC view indefinitely; actual worker/late-claim closure is imported, not proved by buffer count

publicationCosts.removedWork: Drain native borrowers before destructive release; drain result readers/children before ticket reuse
publicationCosts.bound: Zero permitted disposal while borrowed; zero refund from unknown outcome or delivery ACK
publicationCosts.condition: A scalar release error may already have freed storage; typed disposition still required

publicationCosts.removedWork: Remove owner-return dependency without waiting for observers during GC
publicationCosts.bound: Eligible saved reverse wait minus freeze/scan/trace/reload costs
publicationCosts.addedCost: Independent scanning, trace publication, owner reload and admission costs
publicationCosts.condition: No finite bound on arbitrary native effects, no measured pause reduction or fairness proof

publicationCosts.removedWork: Reuse one record/right through escrow and wrapper phases
publicationCosts.addedCost: Safe shells, stable result cells and delayed unknown outcomes may raise peak
publicationCosts.condition: No sum of independent maxima or refund on slot commit; no whole-round peak reduction proved

publicationCosts.removedWork: Retain exact record when stop/body/root/custody is uncertain
publicationCosts.bound: Native outcome query creates zero additional invocation; unknown stop cannot authorize initialization takeover
publicationCosts.addedCost: Potentially indefinite retained native allocation, shell, roots and ticket
publicationCosts.condition: Only known safe shell/input roots/stopped writer permits GC cut; arbitrary linked half-object remains unsupported

publicationCosts.removedWork: Scheme emits semantic/frame/origin metadata; modern C owns shared escrow service
publicationCosts.bound: One set of gate/slot/right/lease support reused across accept/process/message and callback adapters
publicationCosts.addedCost: Source corrections, root ABI and C-memory refinement remain necessary
publicationCosts.condition: No incremental Zig runtime-work saving established; no production path retired

nodes.labelText: Protect inputs + per-invocation record\nreserve result/root/right slots
Close managed writers and admission\npublish immutable descriptor set
Collector owns root-cell relocation\ncurrent trace receipt + scan-pin drain
Late native-only result\nexact invocation generation; no managed edge
Known safe FOREIGN shell\nescrow retains native disposal authority
Body ready + result rooted\ncanonical slot / ReleaseRight commit
Child callback record before marker allocation\ncomplete parent chain, distinct result slot
Current whole-round seal + binding\nconsume view; reload relocated roots
Original owner / top live marker\nquery canonical result then deliver once
Borrowers drain -> native disposal\nreaders/children drain -> record/ticket reuse
Unknown stop / root / body / handoff\nretain custody; refuse this permission
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and C-memory refinement open

diagramEdges.labelText: view publication is not trace completion
only with known stopped writer / safe shell

callers.actualChain: Native pointer precedes FOREIGN allocation; still allocation may invoke GC before wrapper exists
callers.hazard: C stack result is not a canonical rooted slot; caller completion cannot be GC closure gate
callers.replacement: Pre-reserved escrow/result/root record before native production and allocation entry

callers.actualChain: Allocator links still object, sets refcount/length/header; caller fills body before next allocation
callers.hazard: List publication precedes full body initialization; an independent scanner/sweep cannot assume body ready
callers.replacement: Valid default shell before shared admission plus canonical initialization state; exact source change and ordering required

callers.actualChain: Write tags, release_fn, ptr then *obj; release_foreign clears fields before calling arbitrary function
callers.hazard: Field stores are not a multi-location custody commit; early legacy cleanup can dispose escrow-owned payload
callers.replacement: Canonical ReleaseRight consulted by GC/explicit dispatch; root-before-commit; retain C raw-pointer borrow contract

callers.actualChain: FOREIGN scan skips payload; still refcount!=0 seeds scan list
callers.hazard: Opaque scan does not prove safe finalization or pin managed dependencies; refcount one only covers current collector protocol
callers.replacement: Separate shell validity, dependency roots and native disposal authority; scanner reads initialized descriptor locations

callers.actualChain: RC per-PSTATE list, header data assignment and mark_array relocation; cleanup_rc frees chain unconditionally
callers.hazard: Frozen root values are not immutable; naked RC link/data mutation can race independent scanning or teardown
callers.replacement: Stable root cells, exclusive collector write authority and drained physical list transfer

callers.actualChain: make_vector allocates marker before copying proc_or_false; explicit TODO says it may have been collected
callers.hazard: Depth counter and post-allocation marker root cannot protect procedure before allocation GC
callers.replacement: Protect procedure and ancestor/result records first; admit child with its own ticket before marker allocation

callers.actualChain: ___call creates return-to-C frame, saves stack marker, executes trampoline and checks unwind destination
callers.hazard: Shared result slot or parent reentry while child is live violates real C-stack matching
callers.replacement: Per-invocation frame chain/result identity; LIFO owner return and exact marker checks

callers.actualChain: Return handler checks processor and marker validity; kill marker sets false and decrements still refcount
callers.hazard: Root preservation cannot authorize returning to an invalid C frame or another processor
callers.replacement: Current binding/marker lifetime required in reentry; dead marker stays invalid

callers.actualChain: SFUN conversion errors store temp1..4 and can call Scheme error handler again before marker kill/error propagation
callers.hazard: Nested error callbacks can allocate/exit; post-notification success does not settle parent custody
callers.replacement: Per-frame error/result roots and explicit unwind cleanup; no shared singleton escrow or implicit early refund

callers.actualChain: CFUN context writes and reloads GVM state; error handler uses processor temps
callers.hazard: Permit alone without fresh relocated roots/fp/hp/binding is insufficient
callers.replacement: Consume whole-round permit then acquire/reload original owner context before managed work

callers.actualChain: scheme_call_cmd reads RC-held vector, invokes tcltk_call, passes allocated C string to Tcl release_string callback
callers.hazard: Managed return, native C string ownership and Tcl result lifetime have distinct endpoints
callers.replacement: Distinct Scheme/rooted result slot and native result custody; no cross-library exception equivalence assumed

callers.actualChain: Allocate RC and still vector; assign procedure and RC data; delete releases vector/RC
callers.hazard: Delete/cleanup can race in-flight callback; addref does not defeat cleanup_rc
callers.replacement: Invocation leases, child/reader drain and physical owner transfer before teardown; imported Tcl semantics remain open

callers.actualChain: Message consumed before conversion; process error mapping/dev ownership gap; client wrapped but server cleaned on failure
callers.hazard: A late result or unknown cleanup cannot become EINTR/EAGAIN or another native invocation
callers.replacement: Bind exact origin/payload/generation to canonical slot; prior three source correction gates preserved
